name: Shadow Boxing

instructions.description: Stand in a stable staggered stance with hands near the chest.
Extend one arm in a controlled punch and return it.
Alternate arms while lightly shifting weight.
Keep the pace smooth and avoid snapping the elbows.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the time performed with comfortable, controlled technique.
Record the individual's perceived effort after the exercise.
Use a consistent reviewer-defined quality scale for control and alignment.

variations.variationDescription: Shadow Boxing — Interval Progression: Alternate manageable work and recovery periods while keeping the same activity.

commentsNotes: Use controlled punches without locking the elbows.
